svg.title: Keep the folds. Turn one arm.
svg.desc: Six orbital line drawings share one scale and the original arm lengths 245, 140, and 65. The upper row uses rhythms eight and six, giving seven rotational folds. The lower row uses fifteen and thirteen, giving fourteen folds. In each row, the backward arm starts at zero, a quarter turn, and a half turn. The petal shapes change while their rotational fold counts stay fixed. The three phases are blue, gold, and green. Small center marks locate the origin. The curves are sampled illustrations with geometric position error less than 0.005 sheet units, including rounded coordinates. Links at the bottom open the original zero-phase drawings.

g.text: Keep the folds. Turn one arm.
The rhythms stay. Change where the backward arm begins.
The same scale and arm lengths. Seven folds above, fourteen below.
The same three arm lengths: 245, 140, 65. Only one starting angle changes.

a.text: From petals to a ring: follow the little ellipse inside the turn ↗
